title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for  regional provision of service"

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s)
entities.description: Indicates the forbidden tracking area identities to be stored in the list of forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service. This IE is included only when the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.

entities.name: Satellite E-UTRAN access condition
entities.description: Condition that the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access, which determines when the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is included.

entities.name: Storage in forbidden tracking areas list
entities.description: Property indicating that the forbidden TAI(s) are to be stored in the list of forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service.

relations.description: The inclusion of the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is guarded by the condition that the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.
The Forbidden TAI(s) IE establishes that the forbidden tracking area identities are to be stored in the list for regional provision of service.
